title: Flat-term tensor realization of a strict DVR coefficient sequence
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and any scheme $X$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. On the small pro-etale site let $C_m=(\mathcal O_E/\pi^{m+1})_X$, $B=\lim_m C_m$, and $q_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$ be the prescribed quotient map [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-sf-strict-dvr-coefficient-sequence-data]. Let $P$ be an unbounded cochain complex of $B$-module sheaves whose every term is flat [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Suppose given $B$-linear $a_n:C_0\to C_{n+1}$ and short exact sequences $0\to C_0\xrightarrow{a_n}C_{n+1}\xrightarrow{q_n}C_n\to0$ for every $n\geq0$. Set $P_m=\operatorname{Res}_{B\to C_m}(P\otimes_B C_m)$ using the recorded unrestricted scalar-extension complex and let $t_n:P_{n+1}\to P_n$ be its prescribed quotient chain map [def-sf-unrestricted-reduction-complex-constructions, def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction]. There exist chain maps $i_n:P_0\to P_{n+1}$ taking every local sheafified pure tensor $s\otimes x$ in every degree to $a_n(s)\otimes x$, and $0\to P_0\xrightarrow{i_n}P_{n+1}\xrightarrow{t_n}P_n\to0$ is degreewise short exact. No K-flatness, bound or geometric finiteness hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Reuse the already proved generic ordinaryExtension, tensorExtensionIso and normalized extensionTensorIso_tmul helpers from SuccessiveQuotientFlatTensorSequence. The object and map equations of scalarReductionExistence identify its chosen ordinary functor with ordinaryExtension. Compose the natural isomorphisms to obtain the normalized comparison C_m tensor - to recorded scalar extension followed by restriction.

Apply sheaf tensor bifunctoriality to a_n and q_n, then transport through these functor isomorphisms and apply the induced functors on cochain complexes. The injection sends s tensor x to a_n(s) tensor x. The quotient sends s tensor x to q_n(s) tensor x; the unique pure-tensor characterization of the prescribed quotient transition identifies this chain map with t_n. Thus these are actual chain maps of the recorded complexes.

The tensor of the coefficient zero composite is zero. In each degree j, apply - tensor P^j to the assumed coefficient short exact sequence. Flatness is exactly exactness of this functor; the normalization comparisons transport its short exact image to the asserted evaluated row. No statement about pointwise flatness of sections is used.

theorem strictDvrFlatTensorSequence
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
    (hflat : ∀ j : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) (P.X j))
    (a : ∀ n : ℕ, strictDvrFiniteCoefficient l E X 0 ⟶
      strictDvrFiniteCoefficient l E X (n + 1))
    (hseq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ hz : a n ≫ strictDvrCoefficientQuotient l E X n = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk (a n) (strictDvrCoefficientQuotient l E X n) hz).ShortExact) :
    ∃ (i : ∀ n : ℕ, unrestrictedTowerComplex l E X 0 P ⟶
        unrestrictedTowerComplex l E X (n + 1) P),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (strictDvrFiniteCoefficient l E X 0).val.obj U)
        (x : (P.X j).val.obj U),
        ((i n).f j).val.app U (unrestrictedTowerTensorSection l E X 0 (P.X j) U s x) =
          unrestrictedTowerTensorSection l E X (n + 1) (P.X j) U
            ((a n).val.app U s) x) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ hz : i n ≫ unrestrictedTowerTransition l E X P n = 0,
        (∀ j : ℤ, ((ShortComplex.mk (i n) (unrestrictedTowerTransition l E X P n) hz).map
          (HomologicalComplex.eval (scalarReductionSource l E X) (.up ℤ) j)).ShortExact)
